verdict.rationale: Sierra's Voice product explicitly delivers phone-based agent interactions replacing IVR, with voice personas across 55-60+ languages, and the Agent SDK/Studio explicitly states 'build once, deploy across any channel—chat, phone, email, SMS' implying shared knowledge/logic/actions across channels. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of voice call quality/parity with chat and no direct evidence of shared knowledge base being identical across channels in a real deployment.
